name: Willys MB jeep
blurb: The U.S. Army's small four-wheel-drive truck, listed as friendly airfield scenery. It is not in the game yet.
history:
The Willys MB, officially the U.S. Army Truck, 1/4-ton, 4x4, Command Reconnaissance, was built from 1941 to 1945. Willys-Overland built it as the MB and Ford built it to the same design as the GPW, more than 359,000 and 277,000 respectively. It was powered by Willys' four-cylinder "Go Devil" engine.

The jeep served in every theater of the Second World War and again in Korea.
